scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,playground -c cyan,magenta,green "pnpm --filter @laundrytwin/api dev" "pnpm --filter @laundrytwin/web dev" "pnpm --filter @laundrytwin/playground dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @laundrytwin/api build && pnpm --filter @laundrytwin/web build && pnpm --filter @laundrytwin/playground build
scripts.check: pnpm --filter @laundrytwin/api check && pnpm --filter @laundrytwin/web check && pnpm --filter @laundrytwin/playground check && pnpm --filter @laundrytwin/etl check
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @laundrytwin/api test && pnpm --filter @laundrytwin/web test && pnpm --filter @laundrytwin/etl test
